import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class C {
    static final int INF = (int) 1e6;
    static int[][][][] dp;
    static String numStr;

    public static int solve(int idx, int posCount, int negCount, int carryOffset) {
        int trueCarry = carryOffset - 50;
        if (idx == 17) {
            return (posCount + negCount + trueCarry == 0) ? 0 : INF;
        }
        if (dp[idx][posCount][negCount][carryOffset] != -1) {
            return dp[idx][posCount][negCount][carryOffset];
        }
        int best = INF;
        for (int p = 0; p <= Math.min(15, posCount); p++) {
            for (int q = 0; q <= Math.min(15, negCount); q++) {
                int sum = posCount - negCount + trueCarry;
                int digit = (sum % 10 + 10) % 10;
                int nextCarry = sum > 0 ? sum / 10 : (sum - 9) / 10;
                if (digit != numStr.charAt(idx) - '0') continue;
                int cost = solve(idx + 1, posCount - p, negCount - q, nextCarry + 50) + (p + q) * (idx + 1);
                if (cost < best) best = cost;
            }
        }
        return dp[idx][posCount][negCount][carryOffset] = best;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long input = scanner.nextLong();
        int bound = 50;
        dp = new int[20][bound][bound][100];
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < bound; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < bound; k++) {
                    Arrays.fill(dp[i][j][k], -1);
                }
            }
        }
        numStr = Long.toString(input);
        while (numStr.length() < 17) {
            numStr = "0" + numStr;
        }
        numStr = new StringBuilder(numStr).reverse().toString();
        int answer = INF;
        for (int p = 0; p < bound; p++) {
            for (int n = 0; n < bound; n++) {
                int candidate = solve(0, p, n, 50);
                if (candidate < answer) answer = candidate;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
